picker_subtitle: Pick a role and explore the app like a real user.
picker_notice: Nothing is sent or saved. You can switch roles at any time.
role_parent_desc: Manage your children and the people allowed to collect them.
role_collector_desc: Show your QR code at school to collect a child.
role_establishment_desc: Scan a QR code and check the authorization live.
badge_a11y: Demo mode, fictional data. Open the demo menu
restart_confirm_body: The fictional data goes back to its initial state.
guide_parent_1: See your collectors in the Collectors tab.
guide_parent_2: Add a person allowed to collect Emma or Lucas.
guide_parent_3: Open the QR Code tab to generate a pickup code.
guide_collector_1: Find the children you are allowed to collect.
guide_collector_2: Open the QR tab to generate your code, valid for 24 hours.
guide_collector_3: Show this code to the school, which checks it.
guide_establishment_2: Scan one of the five QR codes on the stand.
guide_establishment_3: See the result of the check.
scanner_demo_hint: No camera? Pick one of the five QR codes on the stand.
qr_note_authorized: This person holds a valid authorization.
qr_note_child_specific: The authorization is tied to this specific child.
qr_note_temporary: Temporary authorization, still valid for a few days.
qr_note_parent: QR code generated by the parent.
qr_refused_unauthorized: This person is not authorized to collect this child.
qr_refused_expired: This code is no longer valid. Ask for a new QR code.
qr_refused_used: This QR code has already been used. It works only once.
qr_refused_revoked: The parent revoked this person's authorization.
qr_refused_authorization_expired: This person's temporary authorization has expired.
qr_refused_demo_in_production: This QR code is a demo example. It cannot be used for a pickup.
demo_action_unavailable: This action is not available in demo mode.
seed_notif_parent_body: Sophie Martin collected Emma at École des Tilleuls.
seed_notif_collector_body: École des Tilleuls validated your pickup of Emma.
